columns.comment: Fictional staff id (SYN-P-nnnn); join to gold.dim_employee.
columns.name: employee_id

columns.comment: Staff name (fictional); role + id (e.g. Onboarding Officer SYN-P-0211) when no source records a name.
columns.name: employee_name

columns.comment: Primary role: RM, Credit Analyst, Credit Approver, TB Sales or Onboarding Officer.
columns.name: role

columns.comment: All roles the person appears in across systems, comma-separated (e.g. Credit Analyst, Credit Analyst (checker)).
columns.name: roles_seen

columns.comment: Team: <segment> Coverage for RMs (by the segment most of their accounts belong to), Credit Risk Management, Credit Approval, Transaction Banking Sales or Client Onboarding & KYC.
columns.name: team

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location) the person works from: CRM team record; onboarding officers the booking country most of their cases are in; otherwise the Singapore hub.
columns.name: coverage_office

columns.comment: CRM RM code (RM001-RM120) for relationship managers; null for other roles. Unique.
columns.name: rm_code

columns.comment: True for relationship managers (primary or secondary RM on CRM accounts).
columns.name: is_relationship_manager

columns.comment: True when a source system records the person's name (false = role-based display name).
columns.name: has_recorded_name

columns.comment: Golden clients for which the person is the current primary RM in CRM.
columns.name: primary_clients_current

columns.comment: Client groups with at least one client for which the person is the current primary RM.
columns.name: primary_groups_current

columns.comment: Current CRM account-team assignments in any team role.
columns.name: team_assignments_current

comment: Fictional SMBC APAC staff seen in the source systems: relationship managers (RM001-RM120), credit analysts, credit approvers, TB sales and onboarding officers, with role, team, coverage office and current client coverage. Facts that record an RM code (e.g. crm_activity.rm_code, owner_rm) join on rm_code to get employee_id. Names come from the CRM team records; staff who never appear there (approvers, onboarding officers) carry a role-based display name. Grain: one row per staff member (employee_id).
